first_admin_bootstrap.command: cd backend && python -m app.cli.create_admin --username admin --email admin@yourcompany.com --password STRONGPASSWORD
first_admin_bootstrap.note: Run server-side (SSH) or locally with DATABASE_URL pointed at Supabase

admin_login.returns: access_token (use as Bearer in admin API calls)

list_invites.note: Shows code_prefix only, never plaintext code

revoke_invite.note: Permanently deletes the invite. Already-registered users are not affected.

admin_frontend.note: Login first at the main app, then navigate to /admin/invites
admin_frontend.requirement: localStorage access_token must be set with an admin-account token

wave1_checklist: 5. Send codes out-of-band to selected users
